summary: This is an 8-K filed by Capital One Funding, LLC (depositor) and Capital One Multi-Asset Execution Trust (issuing entity) reporting the issuance of Class A(2026-1) and Class A(2026-2) asset-backed notes on July 16, 2026. The filing also discloses the Master Trust Transferor Interest of $9.73 billion (~75.35% of aggregate adjusted outstanding ABS interests) to satisfy U.S. risk retention rules. This is a routine ABS issuance filing with no merger, acquisition, activist, or restructuring activity. It is a standard structured finance transaction reporting new note issuance and regulatory compliance, not a special situation.
